selection_policy: One admitted candidate and independent challenger until its admission/decision is clear; new genuine evidence may justify changing conditional priority.

records.blocker: Complete article uninspected; no new complete-copy route identified in the last bounded pass.
records.reopening_condition: A legitimate full copy supplied or one genuinely new identified route.
records.bounded_first_step: Inspect that copy/route only; then extract exact writing/carrier/operation argument and compare responsibility against strongest counterparty/category rival.
records.stop_condition: Access remains unresolved, or full argument adds no independent differentiating writing-to-relation link.

records.blocker: No candidate with a known discriminator is selected by this baseline.
records.reopening_condition: An exact packet, serious rivals, different predictions, independent observable relation, concrete evidence path and finite scope.
records.bounded_first_step: One candidate intake plus independent challenge; permit explicitly bounded discovery if the differentiating evidence is still being sought.
records.stop_condition: No stable target or no serious decision-changing observation/path; record exploration/access outcome without promoting it to a semantic test.

records.reopening_condition: Independent product/capacity/production/commission/allocation relation at the component and marking event, or controlled differentiating contrast.
records.bounded_first_step: Verify only the new observation against the existing source branches and strongest alternative before broader work.
records.stop_condition: The blocker is unchanged or the strongest serious rival remains equally compatible.
